description: Source code for the Nordic Semiconductor NPM6001 regulator driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing voltage regulation, mode control, and error handling via I2C.

methods.name: regulator_npm6001_ldo0_list_voltage
methods.description: Lists available voltages for LDO0 regulator.

methods.name: regulator_npm6001_buck012_set_voltage
methods.description: Sets voltage for Buck0, Buck1, Buck2 regulators.

methods.name: regulator_npm6001_buck0123_get_voltage
methods.description: Gets voltage for Buck0, Buck1, Buck2, Buck3 regulators.

methods.name: regulator_npm6001_count_voltages
methods.description: Counts available voltage options based on source.

methods.name: regulator_npm6001_list_voltage
methods.description: Lists voltage for a given index.

methods.name: regulator_npm6001_get_voltage
methods.description: Gets current voltage of the regulator.

methods.name: regulator_npm6001_set_mode
methods.description: Sets the mode (PWM or other) of the regulator.

methods.name: regulator_npm6001_get_mode
methods.description: Gets the current mode of the regulator.

methods.name: regulator_npm6001_get_error_flags
methods.description: Retrieves error flags such as over-temperature or over-current.
